transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you into the clinic to see me today?

Um... I guess I've just been having some things happen at work. I work at a garage, and... well, I just keep hearing this man's voice. 

It sounds like it's coming from the garage vents. Sometimes from right under the hood when I'm working. It's... it's clear. Like somebody is standing right next to me. He just... he keeps telling me not to trust my husband. And... not to touch certain cars. 

So... yeah. That's why I'm here, I guess.
About how long ago did you first start hearing this voice?
Um... it's been a while. I guess... probably about ten months now. That's when the voice started. And... when I started noticing the tracking stuff, too. So, yeah. About ten months.
During these past ten months, have you been experiencing feelings of depression or persistent low mood?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I just... I go to work and come home. That's all.
Do you use any recreational drugs?
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions or had any major physical health issues?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I'm pretty healthy, physically. I don't go to the doctor much.
Do you ever feel like thoughts that aren't your own are being put directly into your mind?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I think my own thoughts. That's all.
How often do you hear this voice speaking to you?

Um... it keeps happening. A lot. I guess that's what brought me in. It's... it's just a man's voice. I hear it coming from the garage vents at work. Sometimes from under the hood. It's really clear... like somebody is standing right next to me. He just... he tells me not to touch certain cars. And... not to trust my husband.
Earlier you mentioned noticing some tracking stuff—could you tell me more about what you've been experiencing with that?

Um... I don't really know what else to say about it. I know it probably sounds... far-fetched. But I'm still convinced they're doing it. My husband and... the shop owner. 

They've been using the EV chargers. And the security cameras at the shop... just to track what I'm doing. They try to show me the footage and say there's nothing there, but... I know they are. That's all.
